description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Optional which extends HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Required. It provides functionality for optional child element definitions within an HTML purifier library, allowing for elements with no children or variable children based on configuration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Optional
classes.description: A class representing optional child element definitions, allowing for no children or flexible children, extending the required child definition.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates the children of an element, returning true if empty and allowed, or the original children if whitespace is permitted.
